triage.reason: Start here — two minutes that explain how the whole workspace fits together.

digest.summary: An orientation to Second Brain's core loop: capture anything, let AI triage and analyze it, read with digest and critique beside the original, and watch new captures connect to what you already know. Emphasizes that every AI output is editable and everything is plain local files.

highlights.text: The AI reads first, and you spend your judgment only where it counts.
Capture your first link in the box above, or grab the starter pack and let your agent build you a small library.
Everything lives as plain files on your machine — no database, no cloud, no lock-in.

concepts.definition: The score, read-time estimate, and verdict every capture receives — the panel beside each document.
Two separate analyses: the digest helps you understand a source; the critique helps you evaluate it.

structure: Premise: attention is the scarce resource
The loop: capture, triage, read with analysis, connect
Next step: first capture or starter pack

hiddenAssumptions: AI triage is trustworthy enough that skipped items are safe to skip.
Users prefer verdicts over browsing everything themselves.
potentialIssues: A miscalibrated score could bury something important — verdicts should be checked against your own judgment early on.
needsVerification: Whether the scoring matches your taste; rate a few sources to teach it.
biasIndicators: Written by the product about itself — read the critique tab on real captures to see it argue with material it did not write.

connections.summary: The advanced-features guide picks up where this orientation ends.
connections.details: Once the core loop is familiar, the advanced guide covers the For You feed, the agent panel, Notebook drafting, and profile pages.
